profile.headline: Software Engineer | Java & Spring Boot | Microservices | REST APIs | AWS | Backend & Distributed Systems
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with 10+ years of experience building enterprise applications, REST APIs, microservices, and distributed systems using Java, Spring Boot, AWS, and SQL/NoSQL databases.

My experience spans financial services, insurance, life sciences, with a focus on backend engineering, distributed systems, API integrations, and cloud-native applications.

Enjoy solving technical challenges in a collaborative team, writing clean and maintainable code, and continuously improving my software engineering skills to deliver reliable, high-quality software.

positions.title: Software Engineer (Contract)
positions.locationName: Miami Lakes, Florida, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Supporting enterprise software development initiatives for a banking client, focusing on Java-based microservices, backend engineering, and application integration.

Develop and enhance microservices using Java 25, Spring Boot, and REST APIs. Implement enterprise application integrations, including XML-based data processing and reusable software components.

Work with AWS and Kubernetes-based environments to develop, deploy, and troubleshoot backend applications. Collaborate with engineering team on solution design, implementation, testing, troubleshooting, and code reviews.

Leverage GitHub Copilot and AI-assisted development practices to support code quality, maintainability, and efficient delivery.

Technologies: Java 25, Spring Boot, Microservices, REST APIs, AWS, Kubernetes, XML, GitHub Copilot.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed software solutions and technical prototypes using Java, Spring Boot, React, JavaScript, Python, REST APIs, and AWS cloud technologies. 
 
 Leveraged GenAI and AI-assisted development tools to accelerate application development, automated testing, and rapid prototyping workflows. 
 
Owned system architecture, integrations, backend/frontend development, and technical documentation across multiple initiatives.

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager / Team Lead
positions.description:
Led engineering teams delivering enterprise-scale distributed systems, microservices architectures, REST APIs, and cloud-native applications supporting scalable, high-availability platforms across healthcare, life sciences, fintech, and other enterprise environments. 
 
Designed and implemented scalable backend services, full-stack web applications using Angular and TypeScript, APIs, operational tooling, and AWS cloud technologies supporting containerized services, serverless applications, API integrations, monitoring, and cloud-native infrastructure. 
 
Improved delivery speed and software quality through CI/CD pipeline implementation, automated testing, DevOps deployment practices, infrastructure automation, Agile delivery improvements, and production support optimization. 
 
Owned full software delivery lifecycles spanning requirements analysis, architecture, development, infrastructure configuration, database integration, deployment, and production support activities. 
 
Mentored 41 engineers while guiding 8 of them into leadership roles, fostering a culture of trust, ownership, growth, collaboration, and technical excellence. 
 
Led cross-functional collaboration across engineering, QA, product, UX, architecture, and client stakeholders throughout full software delivery lifecycles.
positions.insights: Skills: Engineering Management · Software Management · Software Solution Management · Systems Development Management

positions.title: Java Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led planning, deployment, testing, and certification activities for enterprise cruise booking applications supporting 6 new cruise ships, improving quality and reducing delivery timelines by 30%. 
 
 Managed application environments, servers, databases, and JVM configurations using Java, Linux, WebSphere, SQL, and web services technologies to support enterprise application reliability and performance. 
 
 Diagnosed and resolved application issues through SQL, stored procedures, web services, and cross-JVM message flow analysis. 
 
 Automated SQL script generation using Spring Boot and JPA, reducing database setup time by 50% and improving deployment efficiency.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Infrastructure · Engineering · Web Engineering · Software Design

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and maintained cloud-based SaaS web applications supporting enterprise business workflows, ensuring clear separation of UI, business logic, and data access layers. 
 
 Implemented backend services, application features, business rules, validations, and integrations using Java, Spring, JPA, JSF, SOAP/REST web services, and SQL databases. 
 
 Collaborated with BA and QA teams to clarify requirements, streamline testing processes, and improve issue resolution efficiency. 
 
 Delivered Docker containers to facilitate early-stage testing, accelerate feedback cycles, and support UAT activities.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Infrastructure · Software Design · Software Industry · Web Engineering

positions.title: Senior Hardware Engineer
positions.description:
Developed, tested, and certified Android phones for world-class reliability, quality, and performance within high-volume production environments. 
 
 Managed hardware, software, and peripheral test plans for technologies including sensors, USB, WiFi, HDMI, and Bluetooth. 
 
 Developed automated test processes and performance validation workflows to improve reliability, consistency, and manufacturing quality across global device platforms. 
 
 Collaborated across hardware, software, and manufacturing engineering teams to diagnose system-level issues, analyze defects, improve yields, and reduce production failures. 
 
 Partnered with US and China factory teams to support large-scale product delivery, operational reliability, and continuous process improvement initiatives.
positions.insights: Skills: Hardware Development · Hardware Infrastructure · Hardware Design · Device Drivers

positions.title: Hardware Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and tested mission-critical public safety radios for the NYPD and Fire Department, ensuring high reliability and performance standards. 
 
 Integrated microprocessors, subsystems, peripherals, and accessories across hardware platforms and device configurations. 
 
 Improved prototype reliability through rigorous testing, validation, troubleshooting, and failure analysis activities. 
 
 Diagnosed and resolved issues at the component, board, and system levels to support product quality and operational reliability.
positions.insights: Skills: Semiconductor Engineering · Engineering · Electrical Design

positions.title: Java Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed and tested Java software for building multi-tier e-business applications, developing AltoStudio and AltoServer tools on WebLogic using J2EE, Swing, and EJB APIs.
positions.insights: Skills: Java Development · Embedded Java · Java · Java Software Development · Software Development

positions.title: Electrical Engineer
positions.description: Designed, characterized, and simulated 256K SRAM for HP printer systems, developing performance models and validating memory modules through detailed testing.
positions.insights: Skills: Semiconductor Engineering · Engineering · Electrical Design

projects.title: IMPACT & RESULTS (Workstate: 2020-2025)
projects.description:
- Mentored 8 team leads, developing 5 engineers into team leads and 1 into a manager.
- Guided 41 consultants, 90.2% showing increasing influence, leading to successful project delivery and higher client trust.
- Led five full lifecycle projects across clients, acting as Team Lead, Product Owner, Scrum Master, and Engagement Advisor.
- Reduced delivery times by 65% through optimizing workflows and boosting team agility.
- Accelerated releases by 35% via automation, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing.
- Built and scaled high-availability, secure cloud systems leveraging AWS services.
- Fostered a culture of continuous technical and leadership development, improving organizational resilience.
- While team was in a QA capacity, achieved high client satisfaction by finding 800+ bugs over 18 months  in client systems, demonstrating excellence and attention to detail.
